title: Fermachi
tagline: Azerbaijan's marketplace for farm machinery, services & produce.
description: A trilingual agricultural marketplace where anyone can rent out farm machinery, hire field services, and buy or sell produce from a single account.
longDescription: Fermachi lets Azerbaijani farmers and providers list and book agricultural machinery, field services, and goods through one unified account – with a server-enforced booking flow, escrow-style payments and platform commission, bidirectional reviews, real-time chat and notifications, and an AI assistant. It's built as a four-part polyrepo: a Laravel 11 REST + WebSocket API on PostgreSQL, a Next.js 16 app dashboard, a Next.js marketing site, and an Expo / React Native mobile client shipping soon.

title: Portfelim
tagline: Turn teaching material into AI exams in minutes.
description: A multilingual, credit-based platform that turns a teacher's photos, PDFs or slides into editable AI-generated exams, quizzes and answer keys – with AI grading and PDF/DOCX export.
longDescription: Teachers upload material, pick question types, difficulty and language, and a multimodal LLM returns a strict-JSON exam plus answer key they edit in a rich TipTap/KaTeX editor before exporting to PDF or DOCX; the same AI grades open-ended answers and generates study materials. Built as a Laravel 13 API (Sanctum, PostgreSQL, queued jobs) with two Next.js 16 front-ends – the app and a separate marketing site.

title: YouCanSupport
tagline: A help-center platform businesses publish on their own domain.
description: A platform that lets businesses create and organize help-center articles, fully customize their knowledge base, and publish it on their own domain.
longDescription: YouCanSupport is a full knowledge-base product: a Laravel application where teams write and organize help-center articles, customize branding, and serve the result on their own domain, fronted by a fast Astro marketing site. I worked across the whole thing – the data model and API in Laravel/MySQL, and the content-first landing page in Astro.

title: Vevy Product AI
tagline: AI-powered Shopify app for product descriptions.
description: AI-powered Shopify app for automated product-description generation.
longDescription: A Shopify app that generates product descriptions with AI. Built full-stack in Laravel: OAuth against the Shopify Admin API, billing, store data sync, and the generation pipeline that turns sparse product fields into copy a merchant will actually keep. Currently in active development.

title: Business Management Systems
tagline: Internal ops & automation on the Google Apps Script API.
description: Internal management, workflow automation, and operational systems for education and hospitality businesses, integrating Google Apps Script APIs to streamline admin work.
longDescription: A set of internal tools for education and hospitality businesses, built in Next.js on top of the Google Apps Script API. Turns spreadsheet-driven processes into real interfaces – workflow automation, operational dashboards, and the day-to-day surfaces staff actually run on.

title: CPM Invest Management System
tagline: Backend & APIs for an investment firm's CRM.
description: Backend services and APIs for an investment company's CRM and internal management platform.
longDescription: The backend behind an investment company's CRM and internal management platform – Node.js and Express over MongoDB. API design, data modelling, and the quiet reliability work that everything else depends on.

title: NOVARC Media
tagline: Futuristic, scroll-driven site for a media company.
description: Futuristic frontend with interactive scrolling for a media company.
longDescription: A media-company site built in Next.js, leaning on interactive scrolling and motion to carry the brand. Front-end focused: animation, layout, and the kind of scroll choreography that has to feel weightless.

title: Capital Construction
description: Corporate landing page focused on responsive UI and SEO optimization.
longDescription: A corporate landing page in Next.js for a construction firm – responsive UI, clean structure, and SEO optimization. The kind of site whose whole job is to load fast, read clearly, and convert.

title: Remind Notification
tagline: Landing page for a reminder product.
description: Landing page for a reminder / notification product, built in Astro.
longDescription: A lean, static landing page for a reminder and notification product – built in Astro for instant loads and easy upkeep. Front-end focused: clean layout, quick delivery, no moving parts to maintain.
